last_n_position_holders.sparqlTemplate: SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?startDate ?endDate WHERE {{ ?item wdt:P39 wd:{position} . ?item p:P39 ?statement . ?statement ps:P39 wd:{position} . OPTIONAL {{ ?statement pq:P580 ?startDate . }} OPTIONAL {{ ?statement pq:P582 ?endDate . }} SERVICE wikibase:label {{ bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],es,en". }} }} ORDER BY DESC(?startDate) LIMIT {limit}
